summary: Smoke test of TurismERP (Romanian travel agency). Backend auth, CRUD listing, atomic seat logic, payment/overpay validation, status transitions all verified against public URL. Frontend login → dashboard → all 8 nav sections loaded with seeded data and charts render.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials returns JWT + user
POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401 'Email sau parolă incorecte'
GET /api/auth/me returns current user with Bearer token
Packages include joined destination object (destination key populated)
Reports dashboard returns kpi, reservations_per_client, popular_packages, revenue_by_method
POST /api/clients duplicate email → 400 'Există deja un client cu acest email'
POST /api/reservations happy path: 2 pax x 4500 RON = valoare 9000, locuri 11→9
POST /api/reservations overbook (20 pax on 9 remaining) → 400 'Locuri insuficiente pentru acest pachet'
POST /api/payments partial (4000/9000) 200; overpay → 400 'Suma depășește soldul rămas (5000.00 RON)'
PUT /api/reservations/{id}/status ANULATA restores locuri 9→11 (uses body key 'stare')
Frontend: login page renders, submitting credentials navigates to /dashboard
Dashboard shows KPIs (Rezervări totale 10, Venit 41.700 RON, Clienți 8, Pachete 8) and Recharts (Pachete populare, Venit per metodă)
Sidebar navigation to Clienți, Rezervări, Pachete, Rapoarte works; tables populated (10/10/8/8 rows) with no error elements
notes: Reservation status PUT expects body {"stare": "ANULATA"} (not "status"); confirmed by server.py. Employee salariu and numar_persoane validations are pydantic-level (422), Romanian domain errors (email duplicate, locuri insuficiente, overpay) return 400 with Romanian text as specified.
